tagline.en: San Diego to Casa Grande, over the mountains and the dunes
tagline.zh: 从圣迭戈到卡萨格兰德，越山跨沙丘

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣迭戈，与 I-5 相接

end.zh: 亚利桑那州卡萨格兰德，与 I-10 相接

en: I-8 begins at the Pacific in San Diego and ends in the desert south of Phoenix, and almost everything interesting about it happens in the first hundred miles. Leaving the coastal plain it climbs into the Laguna and In-Ko-Pah mountains, threading canyons on separated carriageways that sit at different elevations, then drops off the escarpment into the Imperial Valley — a descent of several thousand feet in a few miles.

Below the mountains the road becomes something quite different: a sea-level route across irrigated farmland, then across the Algodones Dunes, then over the Colorado River at Yuma and out into the Sonoran Desert. The Arizona half is long, straight and sparsely served, with the towns spaced by the practicalities of fuel and water rather than by settlement patterns.

The two states divide the route almost exactly in half. It is not a long Interstate by the standards of the system, and it connects no large city to any other large city — its function is to link San Diego to the Phoenix corridor without going through Los Angeles.
zh: I-8 起于圣迭戈的太平洋岸，止于凤凰城以南的沙漠，而它最有意思的部分几乎都发生在最初的一百英里内。离开海岸平原后，它爬入拉古纳山与因科帕山，以上下行分处不同高程的分离式路基穿行峡谷，随后从断崖跌入因皮里尔谷——短短几英里内下降数千英尺。
山下的道路变成了完全不同的样子：先是穿越灌溉农田的海平面路线，接着穿过阿尔戈多内斯沙丘，再在尤马跨越科罗拉多河，进入索诺拉沙漠。亚利桑那段漫长、笔直、服务设施稀少，沿途市镇之间的距离取决于燃油与饮水的实际需要，而非聚落分布。
两个州几乎正好各占一半里程。以整个系统的标准看，这并不是一条长路线，而且它没有把任何一座大城市连向另一座大城市——它的作用是让圣迭戈通往凤凰城走廊而不必绕经洛杉矶。

en: Sixty miles east of San Diego the alignment met a canyon roughly 450 feet wide and 440 feet deep. The original state design would have taken the freeway through the middle of the town of Pine Valley on the old US 80 alignment; the route was moved south through the canyon instead, which saved the town and shortened the road but required a bridge unlike anything yet built in the country.

The Pine Valley Creek Bridge, opened in 1974, was the first long-span segmental concrete bridge in the United States and the first built here by the cast-in-place balanced cantilever method — casting short segments outward from each pier and post-tensioning them in place until the two arms met in mid-air. Nothing of the kind had been attempted domestically, so the engineers designed the formwork, the form travellers and the movable truss from scratch. The technique became standard practice afterwards.

West of Yuma the road crosses the Algodones Dunes, the same barrier that in 1915 was bridged by a road made of wooden planks laid on the sand. The plank road was replaced by asphalt in 1926, that road became US 80, and US 80 in turn became I-8; a preserved section of the planks survives beside the frontage road.
zh: 在圣迭戈以东六十英里处，线位遇上一条宽约 450 英尺、深约 440 英尺的峡谷。州里最初的设计方案会让高速沿老 US 80 线位穿过派恩谷镇的中心；后来线路改为南移穿越峡谷，既保住了小镇又缩短了里程，但需要一座当时全国前所未见的桥梁。
1974 年通车的派恩谷溪大桥是美国第一座大跨度节段式混凝土桥，也是国内首座采用现浇平衡悬臂法建造的桥梁——从每个桥墩向两侧逐段浇筑并就地施加预应力，直到两条悬臂在半空中合拢。国内此前从未尝试过这种工艺，工程师只能从零设计模板、挂篮和可移动桁架。此后这一技术成为常规做法。
尤马以西，道路穿过阿尔戈多内斯沙丘——1915 年正是这道屏障被一条铺在沙上的木板路跨越。木板路在 1926 年被沥青路取代，那条路后来成了 US 80，US 80 又成了 I-8；如今仍有一段木板被原地保留在辅道旁。

en: The corridor is older than the Interstate. A wagon route over the Cuyamaca Mountains was dedicated in 1912, the plank road crossed the dunes from 1915, and US 80 tied the whole thing together between the wars. The freeway through San Diego was substantially built as US 80 before it acquired its Interstate number in California's 1964 state highway renumbering; east of the city, I-8 replaced US 80 piece by piece as construction moved through Imperial County and into Arizona.

Construction was not uneventful. Labour practices on the Imperial County work led to a federal conviction of an organised-crime figure, and a congressional subcommittee found that Arizona had mismanaged the financial side of its portion. Californian construction finished in 1975 and the Arizona mainline in 1977.

One gap remained: the Colorado River. The old US 80 bridge at Yuma was still carrying the traffic, and its replacement was one of the last projects let before a state construction freeze. The new bridge was dedicated in August 1978 and opened to traffic on 20 September, completing the route. California built it, although Arizona owned half of it.
zh: 这条走廊比州际公路本身更古老。翻越库亚马卡山的马车道于 1912 年通行，木板路自 1915 年起跨越沙丘，而 US 80 在两次世界大战之间把这些路段串成一体。穿越圣迭戈的高速在 1964 年加州公路重编号获得州际编号之前，就已基本以 US 80 的身份建成；城市以东，随着施工推进至因皮里尔县并进入亚利桑那，I-8 逐段取代了 US 80。
施工过程并不平静。因皮里尔县工程中的劳工问题导致一名组织犯罪人物被联邦判罪，国会一个小组委员会则认定亚利桑那在本州路段的财务管理上失当。加州段于 1975 年完工，亚利桑那主线于 1977 年完工。
只剩一处缺口：科罗拉多河。尤马的老 US 80 桥仍在承担交通，而它的替代桥是州政府停建令之前最后发包的项目之一。新桥于 1978 年 8 月举行落成仪式，9 月 20 日通车，全线贯通。桥由加州建造，尽管其中一半归亚利桑那所有。

value.en: $404.2 million — California $288.4 million, Arizona $115.8 million. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 4.042 亿美元——加利福尼亚 2.884 亿、亚利桑那 1.158 亿美元。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

value.en: 348.82 miles: 170.12 in California and 178.70 in Arizona
value.zh: 348.82 英里，其中加利福尼亚州 170.12 英里，亚利桑那州 178.70 英里

figures.source: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

why.en: Caltrans and ADOT each publish counts for their own segments and neither publishes a route total. The spread is extreme: the San Diego end is an urban freeway, while stretches of the Arizona desert section have no interchange for tens of miles.
why.zh: 加州与亚利桑那两州交通部门各自发布本州路段的交通量，均未发布全线总量。沿线差异极大：圣迭戈一端是城市快速路，而亚利桑那沙漠段有些区间数十英里内没有一处立交。

label.en: Imperial County section, character of use
label.zh: 因皮里尔县路段的使用性质

value.en: The 79 miles of I-8 in Imperial County are a four-lane facility with grade separation at every intersection, serving as the county's primary east–west route for both general traffic and goods movement
value.zh: I-8 在因皮里尔县的 79 英里为四车道设施，所有交叉口均为立体交叉，是该县承担一般交通与货物运输的主要东西向通道

trafficFigures.source: Caltrans District 11, I-8 Imperial County Transportation Concept Summary, 2009

value.en: Crosses a canyon about 450 feet wide and 440 feet deep; opened 1974 as the first long-span segmental concrete bridge in the United States, and officially the Nello Irwin Greer Memorial Bridge
value.zh: 跨越一条宽约 450 英尺、深约 440 英尺的峡谷；1974 年通车，是美国第一座大跨度节段式混凝土桥，正式名称为内洛·欧文·格里尔纪念桥

conditionFigures.source: San Diego History Center, The Journal of San Diego History, January 2016

timeline.en: A road over the Cuyamaca Mountains east of San Diego is dedicated.
timeline.zh: 圣迭戈以东翻越库亚马卡山的道路通行。

timeline.en: The California Highway Commission takes over the plank road across the dunes west of Yuma.
timeline.zh: 加州公路委员会接管尤马以西跨越沙丘的木板路。

timeline.en: An asphalt road replaces the planks; it later becomes US 80.
timeline.zh: 沥青路取代木板路，后成为 US 80。

timeline.en: California's state highway renumbering applies the I-8 designation in place of US 80.
timeline.zh: 加州公路重编号以 I-8 取代 US 80 的编号。

timeline.en: The Pine Valley Creek Bridge opens, the first long-span segmental concrete bridge in the country.
timeline.zh: 派恩谷溪大桥通车，成为全国第一座大跨度节段式混凝土桥。

timeline.en: The California portion of the route is complete.
The Arizona mainline is complete except for the Colorado River crossing.
timeline.zh: 亚利桑那主线建成，仅余科罗拉多河跨河段。

timeline.en: The new Colorado River bridge at Yuma opens on 20 September, completing I-8.
timeline.zh: 尤马新建的科罗拉多河大桥于 9 月 20 日通车，I-8 全线贯通。
